title: yapin.js-client plugin index entry
description: plugins/<id>/entry.json. This is what `yapin-client plugin entry` prints. Fields the registry generates at publish time (the served downloadUrl, the signature, the signed file's hash) are not part of an entry.

id.description: The plugin's id. Must equal the folder name, and must never change: it is how clients recognise the plugin and how people's settings are keyed.

description.description: What the plugin does, in one sentence. People read this before installing.

apiVersion.description: The plugin API the plugin was written against. A client refuses a plugin asking for one it doesn't have.

minClientVersion.description: The oldest framework version this works on.

downloadUrl.description: Where the author publishes the file. Recorded as sourceUrl in the index; clients download the registry's signed copy instead.

sourceUrl.description: Same as downloadUrl; either name is accepted.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the committed, unsigned plugin.js.

notes.description: Anything a reviewer wants shown alongside the listing, such as behaviour a signature can't cover.
